mapper.select: SELECT a. user_ques_id , a.ans_status , a.created_at , a.couple_id , b.ques_id FROM tb_user_random_question a JOIN tb_random_question b ON a.ques_id = b.ques_id WHERE couple_id = ( SELECT couple_id FROM TB_COUPLE_LIST WHERE member_id1 = #{memberId} OR member_id2 = #{memberId} )
SELECT a.ques_id , a.ques_content FROM tb_random_question a
SELECT a.ques_id FROM tb_user_random_question a WHERE a.couple_id = #{coupleId}
SELECT ques_id, ques_content FROM tb_random_question WHERE ques_id = #{quesId}
SELECT a. user_ques_id , a.ans_status , a.created_at , a.couple_id , a.ques_id FROM tb_user_random_question a WHERE user_ques_id = #{userQuesId}

SELECT a.user_ques_id , a.ans_status , a.created_at , a.used , a.couple_id , a.ques_id , a.couple_ques_no , b.ques_content FROM tb_user_random_question a JOIN tb_random_question b ON a.ques_id = b.ques_id WHERE a.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND a.couple_ques_no = ( SELECT MAX(couple_ques_no) FROM tb_user_random_question WHERE couple_id = #{coupleId} )
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(a.couple_ques_no), 0) FROM tb_user_random_question a WHERE a.couple_id = #{coupleId}
